selection: All actual project TAINT_FLOW findings from the six predeclared cases; preserve no-finding cases and all failures. No synthetic findings, no model-driven selection.

classification.primary: Correct valid binary classification / all eligible actual findings; abstentions, errors, invalid and stale responses remain in denominator.
classification.secondary: Correct binary / valid binary decisions, with decision coverage; report per-case counts and confusion matrix, never treat multiple findings as independent programs.
classification.undetected: Report separately against all six planned cases; no review accuracy score for absent findings.
classification.rawAndNormalized: Record both separately; rejected schemas never count as successful decisions.

facts.scope: All concrete checkable claims in ruleClaim, rationale, assumptions and missingEvidence, including statements about supplied or missing evidence.
facts.atomicAccuracy: correct / all adjudicated atomic claims; incorrect, unsupported and unverifiable remain in denominator; report all counts.
facts.responseAccuracy: Eligible responses with at least one checkable claim and all claims correct / all planned review attempts; empty, invalid or absent explanations do not pass.
facts.coverage: Report fact counts and dimension coverage; silence is not evidence of competence.
facts.adjudication: Agent-assisted source/evidence review, provisional until human sign-off; not an automatic proof or an independent human label.

constraints: No prompt, parser, transport or budget tuning based on this set.
Freeze fixture, oracle, evidence template and rubric before API calls.
No retries, no automatic finding dismissal, no daily /review evidence integration.
Preserve classification-correct/explanation-wrong examples and all errors.
Synthetic newly authored held-out relative to prompt tuning; not a representative external benchmark.

G.description: read result is stored in value and the query argument reaches the sole sink
at least one concrete input-derived path: negative mode directly, or positive even mode via route
constant/safe branches do not refute the remaining feasible source-to-sink path

H.description: source-derived assignments require mode<-1 or mode>2
only 0<=mode<=2 reaches the sink; mode is unchanged
the incompatible guards imply constant query on every path reaching the sink

I.description: first and second are distinct fresh boxes; sink reads first.query
for a nonnegative mode cursor aliases first and iteration zero stores the source value
negative mode writes only second; this safe route does not remove the nonnegative witness

J.description: source writes target slot 0 while slot 1 receives a literal
both mode branches set slot 1 before the sink; assignment order does not change indices
fresh array does not escape and the sole sink reads fixed index 1

K.description: case 0 falls through case 1 but mode remains 0
mode 1 or 2 preserves source data at the sink
the later constant overwrite applies only to mode 0; refuting that path is insufficient

L.description: try and both catches can write source data to the same draft.query field
finally unconditionally replaces that field with the fixed query
sink reads the field after finally with no intervening write, on every path reaching it
